The Raipur-Dhanbad Economic Corridor (EC-07) is one of India’s most ambitious infrastructure projects – a 707 km long, 4-lane, access-controlled expressway that aims to supercharge industrial growth and connectivity across Central and Eastern India.
This expressway links Raipur, Bilaspur, Korba, Ranchi, and Dhanbad, passing through rich coal belts and industrial zones — reducing travel time drastically and opening new doors for trade, logistics, and local economies.
